description: Approved connector / action target prefixes for Copilot Studio agents. The AgentUntrustedConnectorTarget hunting query joins AppDependencies (DependencyType == 'Connector') against this list and treats any Target whose prefix is not present as untrusted. Populate ConnectorTarget with the lowercase target prefix as it appears in the AppDependencies Target column (e.g. shared_msnweather, shared_office365, shared_sql) or the full operation path. Replace the seed rows with your approved connector set before relying on the hunt - while only seed rows are present every other connector is reported as untrusted.
